**HAProxy** is a free, fast, and reliable reverse proxy for high availability, TCP and HTTP load
balancing, and application traffic management. This component contains the complete English text of
the three core HAProxy 3.4 manuals, reorganized as one flat Markdown reading sequence for OINK.

## Choose a manual {#choose-a-manual}

<div class="haproxy-manual-cards">

{{< cards >}}
{{< card title="Starter Guide" link="/haproxy/load-balancing/" icon="fa-solid fa-compass" badge="9 TOPICS" >}}
Load-balancing concepts, HAProxy architecture, features, sizing, releases, and ecosystem.
{{< /card >}}
{{< card title="Configuration Manual" link="/haproxy/http-fundamentals/" icon="fa-solid fa-file-code" badge="12 CHAPTERS" >}}
Complete configuration-language reference, including proxies, ACLs, samples, logging, filters, and every option family.
{{< /card >}}
{{< card title="Management Guide" link="/haproxy/prerequisites/" icon="fa-solid fa-screwdriver-wrench" badge="13 CHAPTERS" >}}
Startup, reloads, resources, logging, statistics, runtime CLI, debugging, and security.
{{< /card >}}
{{< /cards >}}

</div>

## Edition coverage {#edition-coverage}

| Manual | Upstream source | Local organization |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Starter Guide | 1,695 lines | 9 flat topic pages |
| Configuration Manual | 33,031 lines | 12 flat chapter pages |

All 34 reading pages live directly under the HAProxy component root. Three non-linking divider
placeholders separate the manuals in the sidebar without adding directory levels or pager stops.

The complete pinned inputs and SHA-256 checksums are retained under `sources/haproxy/`. The
[upstream license notice](/third_party/haproxy/LICENSE) and [GPLv2 text](/third_party/haproxy/GPL-2.0)
are published beside the manuals. This edition remains English-only for now.
